* Static utilities to overlay locales on top of another LocaleListCompat. * *

This is used to overlay application-specific locales on top of * system locales.

methods.name: static LocaleListCompat combineLocalesIfOverlayExists(LocaleListCompat overlayLocales, LocaleListCompat baseLocales)
methods.comment:
* Combines the overlay locales and base locales.
     *
     * @return the combined {@link LocaleListCompat} if the overlay locales is not empty/null else
     * returns an empty LocaleListCompat.

methods.name: static LocaleListCompat combineLocalesIfOverlayExists(LocaleList overlayLocales, LocaleList baseLocales)
private static LocaleListCompat combineLocales(LocaleListCompat overlayLocales, LocaleListCompat baseLocales)
methods.comment:
* Creates a combined {@link LocaleListCompat} by placing overlay locales before base
     * locales and dropping duplicates from the base locales.

methodNames: static LocaleListCompat combineLocalesIfOverlayExists(LocaleList overlayLocales, LocaleList baseLocales)
private static LocaleListCompat combineLocales(LocaleListCompat overlayLocales, LocaleListCompat baseLocales)
